cues.text: You checked an app's code. Could that code change later?
On Tari Ootle, every component gets an upgrade rule when it's created. And that rule can't be changed afterwards.
Locked, the default, means nobody can upgrade its code.
Owner means the component's owner can approve an upgrade.
And an access rule hands that power to someone else, like a multisig.
So before using an app, ask: can this component be upgraded, and who can approve it?
One more thing. Locked code is not a safety certificate. Bugs can remain, and owner-controlled settings can still change its behavior.
The real question isn't just, is it on-chain? It's: what can change, and who controls that change?
